notes.title: Twinkleby Screenshot Showcase 💛
notes.content: [h1]Neighbours 💛[/h1][p]We wanted to give a little nudge to our cozy Twinkleby Discord server – join it [url="https://discord.gg/Yb7WmW3WjS"]here[/url] and unite with our growing family of Twinkleby fans! [/p][p]To celebrate the game release and to community-kick things off a little, we thought we'd introduce a ... [/p][p][/p][h3][i][b]Screenshot Showcase[/b] [/i]📷[/h3][p]We just love seeing the various images, streams and impressions from Twinkleby, and how everyone finds new ways to decorate and play with our quirky little space farers. The devs have also gathered some pretty cute pictures that we will share during the next couple of days. [/p][p]We would be thrilled if you would like to share [i]your[/i] best screenshots as well! Cozy, pretty, serene, impressive or eerie, it's up to you! Bonus points for screenshots of the characters in action!  How, you may ask? Easy! Simply upload your screenshots in [url="https://discord.gg/pfkYXkHG"]⁠twinkleby-screenshots[/url]. [/p][p]By the end of next week, we will pick our favourite contribution and who knows, maybe a little twinkle treat awaits! [/p][p]Starting off with these two screenshots from our devs:  [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45575007/b70c24eff3fa2f544756207f5a39982beb18c51a.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]"Autumn Plaza" by Ida.[/i] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45575007/6e52c92eaef434dcb63b9132af4cabc63cddb45b.png"][/img][/p][p][i]"Arrived at last" by Bea.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Introducing the Twinkleby x Camper Van bundle
notes.content: [h1]Friends and Neighbours [b]💛[/b][/h1][h2]We are thrilled to announce that we have teamed up with Camper Van: Make it home – offering you the very best combination of a starlit archipelago and your own cozy home on wheels![/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45575007/ae4c43af42c1467311d2ca6f46145d39cde71061.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The minute we laid eyes on Camper Van: Make it home, we just fell in love with the beautiful and wholesome vibe that the game offers. Celebrating self-discovery, creativity and relaxation we just knew it was a perfect match for Twinkleby! Read more about Twinkleby's new friend here:[/p][p][b]Camper Van: Make it Home[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2843190/Camper_Van_Make_it_Home/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Buy the bundle and you get a 10% discount on both games! Already bought one of them? No worries, you can chose to complete the set and still get a 10% discount on the other game. [/p][p]Enjoy [b]✨[/b][/p]

notes.title: Twinkleby set to launch September 23 ✨
notes.content: [h2]Dear friends & Neighbours![/h2][h3]Drum roll please...🥁🥁🥁 [/h3][h3]...We are incredibly happy to let you know that [b]Twinkleby[/b] will launch on September 23rd! [/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45575007/eff7bc91b48dea095b7a1cd867a6b7c387e74318.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]You can enjoy our cozy decoration delight on PC, Mac, and Linux and with full Steam Deck support. [/p][p][url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ah2G2BiG5q8"]Watch the Twinkleby Release Date Announcement Trailer here![/url][/p][p]In the star-sprinkled universe of Twinkleby, you will furnish dollhouses and decorate lush gardens on floating islands using their ever-growing collection of antiques. But decoration isn’t just for yourself – your creative choices will attract a delightful cast of Neighbours who settle into your cozy designs. Supply them with food and activities, make them happy, or if you change your mind -- evict everyone and throw their furniture into space![/p][p]Don’t forget to add Twinkleby to your Wishlist to be notified as soon as we launch:[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3362960/Twinkleby/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]With more exciting news to follow ✨[/p][p]All the best, [/p][p]Might and Delight team[/p][p][/p][p]PS. Here is a little extra treat of dazzling fresh screens from the game:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45575007/43a0a5481ae191293c3f6d50cbd12474823a14e6.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45575007/d13286535baf076aeec8f63fd35764dc6826ca0b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45575007/b32deb6f92f521e45b931c48b249214a1911ec52.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45575007/c03aaf5bb10a515d89ec52e26ceeaafc2cdab373.jpg"][/img][/p]
